::: {.home-intro}
::: {.home-intro-copy}
Hi, I’m Rey Joseph “RJ” Nieto.

I am a first-class mathematics graduate of the [University of
Bristol](https://www.bristol.ac.uk/), a part-time Saturday instructor at
[Bulacan State University](https://bulsu.edu.ph/), and a columnist for the
[*Manila Bulletin*](https://mb.com.ph/author/rj-nieto). I am pursuing an MSc in
Science, Technology, Engineering and
Public Policy at [University College London
(UCL)](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/prospective-students/graduate/taught-degrees/science-technology-engineering-and-public-policy-msc)
through flexible distance learning. My quantitative work includes statistical
analysis, machine learning, computer vision, and topological data analysis.

My early career developed from technical writing into journalism, national
broadcasting, public affairs, government communications, and programme
delivery. After nearly a decade in political media, I returned to mathematics;
the UCL MSc now brings those strands together through science and technology
policy.
:::

I teach [*Mathematics in the Modern
World*](teaching/bulsu/math-modern-world/index.qmd) and [*Living in the IT
Era*](teaching/bulsu/living-it-era/index.qmd) at Bulacan State University. My
[teaching materials](teaching/index.qmd) include original lecture notes,
exercises, and supplementary resources developed primarily for biology
students.

My [current independent research](research/index.qmd) continues my University
of Bristol dissertation, *Computational Stability of Cubical Homology*, which
received a mark of 90%. The [public
thesis](https://github.com/reyjosephnieto/ph/blob/main/Nieto_TDA_Public_20260430.pdf){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
and [Python implementation](https://github.com/reyjosephnieto/ph){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
document a reproducible, parallelised pipeline tested on 400 retinal images
across ten perturbation protocols and 170 settings. The experiments examined
whether contrasting topological and geometric response profiles could help
distinguish spatial misalignment from radiometric corruption, as a possible
basis for fault isolation in human-led diagnostic workflows.

I write [*Calculated*](calculated/index.qmd), a weekly Saturday column for the
*Manila Bulletin*. The newspaper's [author
archive](https://mb.com.ph/author/rj-nieto){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
provides links to the published essays.

Earlier in my career, I hosted national current-affairs programmes and co-led a
nationwide COVID-19 initiative that delivered more than PHP 25 million in
personal protective equipment to over 100 hospitals. Further details are
available in my [CV](cv/index.qmd) and on
[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/reyjosephnieto/){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}.
